method: ttf.js: (3,1) cmap format 4 of each TTF in C:/Windows/Fonts, code points folded back to bytes as Windows-1252 maps them (U+0000-00FF = the byte itself, the 27 cp1252 code points of 80-9F = their byte, U+F0xx = the byte xx); per code: glyph id, advance (hmtx), sha1 of the raw glyf bytes. Same design = same 4-digit number in the family name (registry: SHREE-KAN7-0850 => S0850890.TTF, SHREE-KAN-0850 => S08500F0.TTF; Shree-Kan7-001/002 => WKAN7001/2.TTF).
